t: This is the Dante Gabriel Rossetti Memorial, a grey granite fountain with a bronze bust set in a panel. It commemorates Rossetti, the English poet, painter and illustrator who founded the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood in 1848 with William Holman Hunt and John Everett Millais. His work inspired writers and artists such as William Morris and Edward Burne-Jones. The memorial was designed by the architect John Pollard Seddon, and the painter Ford Madox Brown made it.
